facts.fact: Logan三天没回短信，Carson疑心是故意冷落
facts.anchor: But it had been days of radio silence. Worse still, I got the feeling that was intentional.

facts.fact: Boone偷看到手机里的KT，警告他别被搅乱心神
facts.anchor: I mind if this chick is fucking with your head.

facts.fact: Logan的建议让他与搭档Boone终于磨合成功
facts.anchor: My fellow defenseman and I were finally getting along after struggling for months to play together, and I had Logan to thank for that.
Levi had ignored me almost the entire game, just like he’d ignored me for the past five years.

facts.fact: 赢下Toronto后她主动短信，随后两人第一次通话
facts.anchor: But when my phone started vibrating, I jolted. KT’s name was displayed on the screen

facts.fact: 她为疏远道歉：对哥哥隐瞒这段友谊像说谎
facts.anchor: “Then why do I feel the need to keep it a secret from my brother?” she whispered.

facts.fact: Carson自认曾背叛Levi一次，发誓不再犯
facts.anchor: I’d already betrayed Levi once. I’d promised myself to never let it happen again.

facts.fact: 她愧疚的导火索：Brightside只肯给她Levi一半的钱
facts.anchor: “You’d think so, but the company wanted to offer me half of what they offered Levi. For the same work.”

facts.fact: Carson把她upstanders的点子报给联盟，联盟要推训练+新规罚款
facts.anchor: They plan to train players and others in the league how to be upstanders—to speak up even when it’s difficult.

facts.fact: 她看穿他打架不为证明什么，而是因为在乎
facts.anchor: “You did it because you care. Because it was wrong.”
